decisions.reason: Direct economics, but +61.5% prior-60-day / +90.1% prior-180-day repricing was large relative to a potentially short-lived logistics dislocation, with uncertain spot-to-realized pass-through.

Official hog prices were rising rapidly while company full-cycle cost had fallen to about RMB14.3/kg. The stock had not experienced comparable recent repricing, and the large direct hog-sales base provided a clear price-cost-spread earnings bridge.
